assumptions: No painted stop line is visible in the first frame, so a proxy stop line was placed near the bottom of the image where cars exit the view.
Travel direction inferred as top-to-bottom because car fronts and headlights face the camera, indicating oncoming movement toward the camera.
Line placed horizontally across all motor-vehicle lanes to apply to every car.
Zone placed immediately upstream of the line on the approach side, with its bottom edge coincident with the line so it touches the line.
Zone lateral extent set to cover car and bus lanes while excluding the left-side red bicycle track.
Zone longitudinal extent set to provide observable waiting area upstream of the line.
raw_output.line_description: stop line across the car lanes
raw_output.travel_direction: vehicles travel from top of image toward bottom and cross the line in the top-to-bottom direction
raw_output.zone_description: waiting area covering the car traffic lanes immediately upstream of the stop line

text: Every car must wait at least 1.5 seconds in the waiting zone before it crosses the stop line.
